subject.title: [Bug]: sessions_yield subagent wake can compact parent branch at low context usage

question: Should OpenClaw add persisted compaction trigger/cause metadata and tighten successful-turn overflow decisions for yielded subagent parent wakes as one combined fix?
rationale: The bug is source-plausible, but the durable repair changes transcript schema/diagnostics and compaction policy around successful turns, which should be owned deliberately.

options.title: Fix Policy And Metadata Together
options.body: Add a bounded compaction policy fix for yielded parent wakes and persist a trigger/cause field on compaction entries with focused regression coverage.

options.title: Policy-Only Fix First
options.body: First prevent low-context yielded-parent wake compactions, and leave trigger metadata for a separate diagnostics schema decision.

options.title: Diagnostics-Only Follow-Up
options.body: Treat existing wake and contextUsage fixes as sufficient for now and only add trigger attribution after another current-main repro.

recommendation.title: Fix Policy And Metadata Together
recommendation.body: Add a bounded compaction policy fix for yielded parent wakes and persist a trigger/cause field on compaction entries with focused regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows broad ownership of agent runtime extraction and session/subagent lifecycle changes, making this the best available routing owner for the policy/schema decision.
